definitions.explanation: A thick cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground.

examples.japanese: {霧|きり}で{前|まえ}が{見|み}えない。
examples.english: I can't see ahead because of the fog.

notes:
{霧|きり} means fog or mist - tiny water droplets suspended near the ground.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {霧|きり}が{出|で}る: fog appears/rolls in
- {霧|きり}が{晴|は}れる: fog clears
- {霧|きり}に{包|つつ}まれる: to be enveloped in fog

WEATHER COMPOUNDS:
- {濃霧|のうむ}: dense/thick fog
- {朝霧|あさぎり}: morning mist
- {霧雨|きりさめ}: drizzle, misty rain

OTHER COMPOUNDS:
- {霧吹|きりふ}き: spray bottle (atomizer)
- {霧島|きりしま}: Kirishima (place name)

IDIOM:
{五里霧中|ごりむちゅう}: being completely lost/confused (lit. in fog for five ri)

SIMILAR:
- もや: haze (lighter than fog)
